title: Schedule of Interest Rates - Larkspur Credit Cards
content:
On the Larkspur Credit Cards, the purchase and cash advance APRs are variable. Each is the Prime Rate plus a margin, stated below in percentage points. The other rows are fixed percentages, billing-cycle counts or day counts.

## Rates by card

| Rate term | Larkspur Secured Visa | Larkspur Classic Visa | Larkspur Cash Back Visa | Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase APR margin over the Prime Rate (percentage points) | 22.24 | 20.24 | 18.24 | 16.24 | 15.24 | 15.24 |
| Cash advance APR margin over the Prime Rate (percentage points) | 26.24 | 26.24 | 26.24 | 26.24 | 26.24 | 26.24 |
| Penalty APR (percent) | 29.99 | 29.99 | 29.99 | 29.99 | 29.99 | 29.99 |
| Days a minimum payment must be past due before the penalty APR may apply to existing balances | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Consecutive on-time minimum payments that remove the penalty APR from existing balances | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Introductory purchase APR (percent) | not offered | not offered | 0 | not offered | 0 | not offered |
| Billing cycles from opening the introductory purchase APR lasts | not offered | not offered | 12 | not offered | 15 | not offered |
| Introductory balance transfer APR (percent) | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 | not offered |
| Billing cycles from opening the introductory balance transfer APR lasts | not offered | not offered | 12 | 18 | 12 | not offered |
| Calendar days after opening within which a balance transfer must post to get the introductory APR | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Purchase grace period (minimum days between statement closing and the payment due date) | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The purchase grace period is the minimum number of days between statement closing and the payment due date. Purchases are interest-free when the previous statement balance is paid in full by the due date.
2. "Not offered" means the card has no such introductory rate. The Larkspur Secured Visa, Larkspur Classic Visa and Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature have no introductory balance transfer APR. The 60-day posting window shown for them therefore has no introductory rate to unlock.
3. The penalty APR is the same fixed figure, 29.99 percent, on every card, as are its 60-day trigger and its 6-payment cure.

## Hypothetical illustration of a variable APR

The Prime Rate below is invented for the arithmetic only and is not a published rate. If the Prime Rate were 10.00 percent:

- the purchase APR of the Larkspur Classic Visa would be 10.00 plus 20.24, that is 30.24 percent;
- its cash advance APR would be 10.00 plus 26.24, that is 36.24 percent.

When the Prime Rate moves, both APRs move with it by the same number of points. The margins themselves do not change.
